title: Lake Country Wine Tour (5 venue)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We will enjoy a relaxing and scenic drive along the north bench to Lake Country. We visit 5 wineries, have a wine tasting experience at each venue, tour the vineyard, and take photos at the most beautiful wineries in the Okanagan.

Please note:
-The venues on our tours may vary depending on availability.
-A minimum of 4 guests is required for public tours. If fewer than 4 people are booked, we may need to reschedule.
